workflow.name: Search a few documents
workflow.description: Finds the passages that best match a question in five built-in help articles, using the built-in local embedder and in-memory search. No model or vector database needed.

documents: Refunds: customers can ask for a refund within 30 days of delivery. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days.
Shipping: orders ship from our warehouse within 2 business days. Express shipping arrives the next business day.
Warranty: every lamp and desk has a 2-year warranty that covers manufacturing defects but not accidental damage.
Support hours: the support team answers chats and emails Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00 UTC.
Accounts: you can change your billing address under Settings, then Billing. Changes apply to the next invoice.
